parent_v6.key_result: evidence channels affected world identity, exact reachability classes and robust-impossibility envelopes differently; target burden was strictly lower than full-world burden in 97/272 eligible rows

scientific_question: If the ecological goal is to identify the truth reachability class rather than the complete generating world, does target-aware adaptive evidence selection choose different measurements and stop earlier than world-identity-oriented evidence selection?

analysis_base.landscapes: reuse the exact 272 v6 eligible full-positive directed-static survivor fibers
analysis_base.baseline: full truth-positive occurrence evidence only; no temporal evidence added before planning
analysis_base.target: truth world's exact directed reachable-node set
analysis_base.world_identity: exact source x barrier-level x analyst-rule candidate world

excluded_action.T_temporal: not included in v7 because the frozen v6 temporal channel is a composite truth-relative arrival-depth constraint rather than one pre-outcome categorical measurement; adding a new temporal outcome model would be a new question

planning_objective.target_planner: exact adaptive decision tree minimizing worst-case number of remaining actions until every surviving world belongs to one exact reachability class
planning_objective.world_planner: exact adaptive decision tree minimizing worst-case number of remaining actions until one candidate world remains
planning_objective.outcomes: all categorical outcomes represented among the current survivor worlds
planning_objective.truth_path: after the tree is frozen from the current survivor state, follow the outcome corresponding to the known truth world

primary_outputs: truth-path action sequence and depth under each policy
remaining world/source count when target planner stops
worst-case target-class count after each candidate first action

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every eligible row, exact worst-case adaptive depth to identify the reachability target is <= exact worst-case adaptive depth to identify the complete world.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row has strictly smaller target-optimal worst-case depth than world-optimal worst-case depth.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if depths are equal in every row.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row with unresolved target and unresolved world has different target-optimal and world-optimal first actions.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if first actions always agree.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row where the first actions differ has a strictly smaller worst-case remaining reachability-class count under the target planner's first action than under the world planner's first action.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every first-action disagreement is target-equivalent.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across eligible rows with unresolved target, at least two of S_source, B_barrier and R_analyst occur as target-optimal first actions.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if one action is always selected first.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every eligible row has finite target-optimal adaptive depth <=3.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any unresolved target after all three channels is an implementation/world-definition failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row reaches a single reachability target class while retaining more than one candidate world and more than one candidate source on the realized truth path.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if target identification always implies full world or source identity.

secondary_outputs: distribution of target and world adaptive depths
first-action frequency by ecological factor stratum
truth-path depth comparison between target and world planners
fraction of rows where target identification stops with multiple worlds
fraction of rows where target identification stops with multiple sources
claim_boundary: The three actions are known-truth categorical diagnostics, not field-cost-equivalent measurements.
Worst-case adaptive depth is a finite decision-tree quantity, not expected information gain.
Target-aware stopping does not identify historical truth when multiple source/world hypotheses remain.
Planner frequencies are conditional on the frozen v6 directed candidate-world universe.
stop_rules: Do not add temporal evidence as a fourth action after scoring.
Do not change tie-break order after scoring.
Do not introduce action weights after scoring.
Do not replace worst-case depth with expected depth after scoring.
